_doc: Every piece of product footage the film uses. To swap in a better drawing: export new clips
from ZexDraws, drop them over these files (or point the paths at new ones), adjust the
replay range below if needed, and run `node render.mjs`. Durations, aspect ratios, frame
rates and the cursor path over the canvas clip are all measured from the files themselves.
replay.skins: one export of the SAME drawing per look, all at the same length (the film
switches between them mid-playback, so their timelines must line up). Keys are fixed:
pink / yellow / orange are the Neubrutalism frame in those preset colours; manga and
replay.useFrom / useTo: the stretch of the replay (seconds) the film plays through. Pick
useTo at or just before the moment the drawing is finished.
replay.skip: optional [from, to] seconds to jump over (e.g. a moment a layer covers the art).
canvas.file: a short clip of the bare canvas while painting (shown inside the studio UI).
Its aspect ratio should match the studio capture's canvas, 1200 x 1584.
